data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic roots 'Nar' (light) and 'Min' (faith), Narmina signifies 'Light of the Faith'. This name is deeply rooted in the Islamic tradition, embodying the radiance of faith and spiritual enlightenment. The name Narmina carries the meaning “Light of the Faith” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Narmina usually hope their child will grow to embody light of the faith and live with faith, good character and purpose.
